Selection mid game - hover re-read live 2026-09-14 and still fixed. The hovered live tile 10120:13452 is 105.271x49.656 at (-2.506,437.867) against 100.258x47.292 for its unhovered siblings - a uniform 1.05, which is TOWER_TILE_HOVER_SCALE = 49.656/47.292. Source-against-node, no browser.

Easy cashout re-read live 2026-09-14.
